top_stories.title: 'NovaCookies' Kit Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions for $320 a Month
top_stories.summary: A phishing-as-a-service kit called "NovaCookies" enables adversary-in-the-middle attacks targeting Microsoft 365 sessions for $320 per month. The service steals session cookies rather than just credentials, allowing attackers to bypass MFA by hijacking authenticated sessions.

top_stories.title: NovaCookies Campaigns Abuse Genuine Docusign Notifications to Steal Microsoft 365 Sessions
top_stories.summary: Researchers have disclosed details of NovaCookies, an adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) phishing toolkit sold as a $320/month subscription service that proxies Microsoft 365 sign-ins to capture authenticated sessions. The toolkit abuses legitimate DocuSign notifications to bypass MFA by stealing session cookies rather than credentials directly.

top_stories.title: Key Reasons Why Identity Fabric Matters in 2026
top_stories.summary: The article explains the concept of Identity Fabric as an architectural approach to unifying fragmented identity systems across cloud services, APIs, and infrastructure. It covers Identity Fabric architecture, risks of unmanaged identities, and the shift from static configuration to runtime visibility in enterprise identity security.

news.title: AI IR Overlay – Incident Response Specification for AI Agents
news.summary: A specification called AI IR Overlay has been published addressing incident response procedures for AI agents, including containment protocols for agents operating with valid credentials. The specification includes a kill-switch contract mechanism but acknowledges a gap in coverage during unstaffed SOC periods.

news.title: How Picnic configured multiple OAuth providers for Amazon MQ
news.summary: Picnic published a technical guide on configuring Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ to trust multiple OAuth 2.0 identity providers simultaneously, using Keycloak for human operators and AWS IAM for services. The post covers broker configuration details for supporting both providers within a single RabbitMQ instance.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks involved credential-based access to Snowflake accounts and resulted in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer call and text records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA issued a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally published dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, to a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management and secrets exposure failures, with security experts drawing lessons for security teams around credential lifecycle management and monitoring.
